slots_and_copies.name: slot_0
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Single EEPROM image read as 64 blocks x 8 bytes from block 0 by FUN_0802458c via FUN_08024704; no slot index, backup copy, or generation counter is traced. Validity is recorded as a boolean at RAM struct +0x23 by FUN_080247e4; no fallback copy exists in the traced code.

checksums.name: save_payload_sum8
checksums.formula_detail: computed = (sum of bytes[0x04..0x11F] inclusive, 284 bytes) & 0xFF; 8-bit char accumulator, no seed/complement/XOR. Stored byte at 0x121 must equal computed; result recorded as bool at RAM struct +0x23 (FUN_080247e4, decompiled.c:2374-2381). Sample match is vacuous (all-zero payload).

io_driver_functions.notes: Generic DMA3 transfer engine: writes src/dst/count|0x80000000 to DMA register triple (pattern of 0x040000D4 block; concrete regs behind unresolved _DAT literals) and busy-waits on bit 0x8000. Used for both EEPROM command-out and data-in transfers; role covers DMA write+read, EEPROM writer itself is NOT traced.

EEPROM single-block read of 8 bytes: builds MSB-first address bitstream with two leading 1 bits on stack, DMAs command to 0x0D000000 (addr_bits+3 halfwords), DMAs 0x44 halfwords back, reassembles 64 bits MSB-first into 4 ushorts written backwards from param_2+6. Bounds-checks block against descriptor field +4, address-bit count from descriptor byte +8. Sole caller via C-text func_0x0804c75c (callgraph lists no callers).

EEPROM type/descriptor selector; traced call passes 4 from FUN_0802457c, selecting descriptor consulted by FUN_0804c75c (block count +4, addr bits +8). Mapping of arg 4 to 4Kbit is hypothesis; selection role is CONFIRMED_STATIC.
EEPROM presence/type probe: returns func_0x0804c694(4) result via unrecovered jumptable; non-zero skips the read in FUN_08024704.

Full-image reader: loops 64 blocks x 8B via FUN_0804c75c into RAM buffer, aborts on first failure, on success calls FUN_080247e4(buffer,1). Bracketed by FUN_08024560 (before) and FUN_08024530 (after, both paths).
Top-level load entry (no traced caller): zero-pre-fills 512B buffer via BIOS MemCopy FUN_0804c664 (SWI 0x0B), probes EEPROM via FUN_0802457c, reads via FUN_0802458c(0xff, buffer, 1).

Validator/deserializer: copies byte0 to RAM struct+0x22, memcpy 284B payload from offset 4 via FUN_0804e900, recomputes sum8 over [4,0x120), compares to byte 0x121 -> bool at struct+0x23, applies 'Z'(0x5A) substitution from byte 0x120, stores 0x53 to unresolved pointer. Also serialize-side checksum writer is NOT traced, so this entry is read-side checksum only.
Word-optimized memcpy (16B unrolled + tail); copies payload [0x04,0x120) to unresolved RAM dest _DAT_08024858. Generic, also used by unrelated functions.
Pre-read hook: clears *_DAT_08024578; FUN_08001dc8 branch not taken for traced arg 0xff. Semantics unknown (jumptable tail).
Post-read hook (both success/failure paths): sets *_DAT_08024558=1; FUN_08001ddc/FUN_08001fe4 branch not taken for traced arg 0xff. Semantics unknown.

open_questions: Where is the EEPROM writer? Absent from the 154-function trace-guided corpus: no write bitstream to 0x0D000000 exists in ghidra/decompiled.c or ghidra/callgraph.json. Its address, serialization order, and stored-checksum computation are unknown.
What are the semantics of byte 0x000, the 'Z' (0x5A) substitution from byte 0x120 in FUN_080247e4, and the unconditional 0x53 ('S') store to unresolved _DAT_08024854 in the same function?

What is the internal field structure of the 284-byte payload at 0x004-0x11F? No writer or per-field consumer was traced and the only .sav sample is blank, so no sub-field can be mapped without fabrication.

What are the concrete RAM addresses behind _DAT_08024850 (save struct base), _DAT_08024858 (payload destination), _DAT_08024874 and _DAT_08024854? Literal-pool values are unresolved in the text decompilation, so RAM mirror addresses are null.

What consumes the checksum-valid boolean at RAM struct +0x23, and does it gate gameplay, show an error, or ignore invalid saves? The validator only records it; note the blank image passes the checksum, so presence detection must live elsewhere.
What are bytes 0x001-0x003, 0x122-0x19F and the 0xFF tail at 0x1A0-0x1FF for? No traced code reads them.

Can sum8 be promoted from CONFIRMED_STATIC to CONFIRMED_VERIFIED? The blank sample match (0x00==0x00) is vacuous; a non-blank game-written save (e.g. induced between sav-00-pre frame 1439 and sav-00-post frame 1473) is required.
What do FUN_08024560/FUN_08024530 hooks and the FUN_0804c694(4) descriptor fields (+4 block count, +8 address bits) resolve to, and what is the second argument passed to FUN_080247e4 by FUN_0802458c?
Is the 0x1A0-0x1FF 0xFF region ever written by the game, or are blocks 52-63 simply never-touched EEPROM cells?
